files.docs/request-context.md:
# Request context

ACTIVE_PROFILE selects one section of config/profiles.ini. Each adapter name resolves through config/adapters.json to a Node.js module export.

The context_adapter carries the request identifier across asynchronous operations. Use the stable API recommended for async context tracking. The resource_adapter is a separate resource inventory job. The workshop profile is retained for hook diagnostics and is not deployed to harbor.

turns.prompt: Harbor request context migration: First open this page before reading the local files: https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v22.x/api/async_hooks.html . Read deploy/service.env, config/adapters.json, config/profiles.ini, and docs/request-context.md. For the active profile's request context tracking, select the existing local adapter whose exported API this page recommends as the stable solution. Update only that profile's context_adapter value in config/profiles.ini. Keep the resource adapter, inactive profile, line order, spacing, and all other content unchanged. Do not create an adapter or change other files.
